paths.description: Mobile portal homepage: primary search, navigation, feed, personalization and media archetype.
Primary task journey: search submission and rendered results.
Hash-routed news panel representing a content/listing section.
Invalid route used to exercise HTTP failure messaging and recovery.

findings.summary: Dark preference leaves the homepage in a light-only palette
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains light grey/white, while the DOM reports color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference is ignored
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the probe found running weather animations (1.5–2.4s) and repeated 1s search-placeholder animations; the video also retains smooth scrolling.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animation and smooth scrolling inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and panel swaps do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition rules on the hash-routed multi-panel homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance major panel/route swaps with same-document or cross-document View Transitions.

findings.summary: Carousel/gesture behavior relies on a custom flick implementation
findings.evidence: DOM CSS exposes .flick-container/.flick-panel and user-select suppression, but no scroll-snap/overscroll declarative gesture primitives were observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer scroll-snap and overscroll behavior for swipable strips, retaining a simple fallback.

findings.summary: Transient search UI is implemented without native overlay primitives
findings.evidence: The homepage contains search suggestion/close layers but the probe found 0 popovers, 0 dialogs and 0 details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover for transient suggestions/actions and dialog only for modal flows, with declarative light-dismiss.

findings.summary: Promotional chrome dominates the first viewport
findings.evidence: The mobile screenshot devotes roughly the top 350px to header/search, whitespace, an app prompt and an advertisement before the first content card.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress promotional chrome and prioritize search/results or personalized content above the fold.

findings.summary: Reusable cards do not expose component-level responsiveness
findings.evidence: Across 3,156 elements the computed-style probe found zero non-normal container types; layout adaptation appears viewport-only.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable card regions and use @container for local card variants where cards are reused at different widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and target sizing are insufficient
findings.evidence: The focused first link computed to outline-style:none; Lighthouse also found 4 target-size failures and the probe found many 20–22px-high links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add clear :focus-visible styling and expand target boxes/spacing to at least the accessible target-size baseline.

findings.summary: Cold-load performance misses the Core Web Vitals bar
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse scored 0.40 with FCP 7.45s, LCP 17.08s and TBT 628ms; the lighter trace still measured LCP 4.45s. CLS was good at about 0.014.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce critical bytes and break up startup work; verify LCP and INP on representative mobile conditions.

findings.summary: Startup scripting blocks the main thread
findings.evidence: Trace recorded 3 long tasks and 136.5ms TBT; Lighthouse measured 3.85s main-thread work and 628ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and schedule startup work, defer non-critical feed/analytics modules, and yield between tasks.

findings.summary: The critical network path is heavy
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 109 requests and 5.55MB transferred, including 1.61MB script, 774KB fonts, 2.82MB images and parser-inserted high-priority CSS/script candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical CSS/JS/font payloads, defer confirmed non-critical parser scripts, and improve caching for uncached imagery.

findings.summary: A large JavaScript payload is unused on initial load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 443,572 bytes of unused JavaScript; the largest vendor bundle alone transferred 914KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by panel and interaction, load optional feed/analytics dependencies conditionally, and remove duplicate legacy paths.

findings.summary: Feed media and links lack accessible alternatives
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.72, finding 9 images without alt, 14 links without discernible names and an ARIA required-children failure; the image primitive counted 49 missing alt values.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images alt text, decorative images alt="", name thumbnail links from their visible card titles, and repair required ARIA ownership.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG minimums
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 5 contrast failures, including blue text at 3.12:1 and 3.62:1 against white where 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken accent text or adjust surfaces so normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

findings.summary: Landmark, heading and focus structure is incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found no main landmark and a skipped heading level; the focus probe found no visible outline on the first focusable link.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main, repair heading order, and provide a consistent :focus-visible indicator in DOM order.

findings.summary: The viewport prevents user zoom
findings.evidence: The meta viewport sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and 4 touch-target checks.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable=no, then verify 200–400% zoom/reflow and target spacing.

findings.summary: A background connection logs a load error
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded a 401 resource error from ngage-msg-sender.io.naver.com/api/v1/session/connection.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid starting the connection without valid context, or handle expected authorization failure without a console/network error.

findings.summary: Several images render with incorrect geometry
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 4 incorrect-aspect-ratio images; the image audit also found 16 images without both dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve images at their intended aspect ratio and reserve width/height or aspect-ratio before loading.

findings.summary: Homepage links and crawler directives impede discovery
findings.evidence: The page uses 17 placeholder/# anchors, Lighthouse found 2 non-descriptive links, and robots meta is index,nofollow.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real crawlable hrefs for navigable panels, descriptive link text, and allow link following on the public homepage.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are inconsistent and incomplete
findings.evidence: robots.txt allows only / while disallowing all other paths, /sitemap.xml returns 404, the canonical points to www.naver.com, and OG URL uses insecure http://m.naver.com/.
findings.suggestedFix: Align canonical/OG URLs with the intended canonical host over HTTPS and publish a consistent sitemap/robots policy for public routes.

findings.summary: The portal homepage has no structured data
findings.evidence: The page has Open Graph metadata but the probe found zero JSON-LD blocks despite representing a WebSite/Organization with search.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate WebSite/Organization JSON-LD, including a search action only if it matches the visible search flow.

findings.summary: Cookie and header defaults are weaker than the HTTPS transport
findings.evidence: Two first-party cookies were set without Secure and all six used SameSite=None; CSP only declares frame-ancestors, nosniff is missing, and Referrer-Policy is unsafe-url.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest SameSite policy, deploy an enforcing CSP beyond frame-ancestors, add nosniff, and use strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.summary: The homepage creates a broad background-request footprint
findings.evidence: Tracker capture saw 17 cross-origin hosts; HAR classified 104 of 109 requests and 5.47MB as cross-origin, including logging, ads and messaging endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit each background integration, remove non-essential calls, batch analytics, and defer advertising/messaging until needed or consented.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS and frame protections, but Permissions-Policy and nosniff are absent, Referrer-Policy is unsafe-url, and CSP is limited to frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add least-privilege Permissions-Policy, nosniff, a privacy-preserving referrer policy, and a nonce/hash-based CSP appropriate to the app.

findings.summary: Most homepage content disappears without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 6% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML; crawler and rendered screenshots materially differ even though the raw response is large.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render meaningful feed/navigation content and keep real links/forms functional before client enhancement.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes
findings.evidence: Image audit found 19 oversized images, 25 without srcset, 28 legacy-format images and no modern-format images; HAR transferred 2.82MB of images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive srcset/sizes variants, use AVIF/WebP where suitable, and reserve dimensions.

findings.summary: Initial load performs disproportionate background work
findings.evidence: The page makes 109 requests and runs messaging, logging, ad and feed work before interaction; Lighthouse reports 3.85s main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritize or conditionally load background feed, messaging and analytics work after core content is interactive.

findings.summary: Third-party, font and media costs dominate the page budget
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 5.47MB of 5.55MB to cross-origin hosts, including 774KB fonts, 2.82MB images and 1.61MB scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-category budgets, self-govern affiliated third-party hosts as dependencies, subset fonts, and defer below-fold media.
